https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/85971 removed company prefixes so remove nvidia from the filename

nit, remove "server" from the name.  This is a switchboard.
Have turned this into a platform config.
Cool, not sure how you've enforced schemas then compared to a normal device.
Haven't enforced schemas for platform configs yet. Do you consider this a blocker for this series of patches?
Platform schema has been added. The platform config in this patch validates fine againt the platform schema.
Remove.  The hardware itself does not have anything to do with /sys.  Find a way to represent the switch, and look these things up where appropraite.
Acknowledged
Won't this be used in inventory? Can we come up with a better naming scheme here? Some of these are GPU SMAs and some are CX8 SMAs
I'll have follow up patches for inventory.

This is essentially a probe for the connectx-8 switchboard.  Not the platform.  There are more MCTP devices on this platform than you've listed (the Xeon CPUs for one), but this probe wouldn't function for those.


I suspect you want to do something like

Found("ConnectX-8") AND FOUND("GB_MGX_BASEBOARD") AND FOUND("RTX60000")
Makes sense, will change and test.
Acknowledged
